name: Deepmoss Egg
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Deepmoss Eggs draw goblin merchants from Ratchet. Deepmoss spiders lay clustered clutches in the crags and canyons, and Booty Bay pirates prize them for omelettes.

sections.title: A Delicacy of the Crags
sections.body: Deepmoss spiders nest across the Stonetalon Mountains, especially in Sishir Canyon and beneath the surviving trees of Windshear Crag. They leave clustered clutches of viable eggs in thick webbed sacks, sheltered by damp mountain moss. Most travelers have little use for them, but goblin traders see a chance to profit.

sections.title: Booty Bay's Culinary Fad
sections.body: Booty Bay has taken to spider egg omelettes, an eccentric culinary fad among wealthy pirates and adventurous diners. Local supplies cannot satisfy their appetite, so Mebok Mizzyrix of Ratchet arranges shipments through Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Collectors brave Stonetalon's venomous broods for fresh clutches, which become valuable cargo.

faq.answer: Deepmoss Eggs are found in the Stonetalon Mountains, northwest of the Barrens. Clutches gather beneath the surviving trees of Windshear Crag and deeper in the venomous dens of Sishir Canyon.

faq.q: Who wants to collect these eggs?
faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin merchant in Ratchet, hires collectors to gather Deepmoss Eggs. He arranges for Wharfmaster Dizzywig to ship the clutches across the sea.

faq.q: What are the eggs actually used for?
faq.answer: The eggs go to Booty Bay, where spider egg omelettes have become a popular, if bizarre, culinary fad among pirates and other diners.

faq.q: Why is Sishir Canyon warned about when gathering them?
faq.answer: Sishir Canyon is a breeding ground crowded with mature spiders, webs, and devoured prey. Mebok advises anyone with a delicate stomach to gather eggs beneath Windshear Crag's sparse trees instead.

angles.text: As a cook, you may hesitate to use spider eggs, but Booty Bay diners prize whipped eggs as an adventurous delicacy and pay goblin prices for them.
